waiting: Waiting for the save file... open the game so it writes a save.

filters.unequippedOnlyTip: Hides only items where every copy you own is equipped. Items with some copies equipped and some in your inventory/stash still show.

summary.listValueTip: Total list value at Steam market prices (what buyers pay)
summary.estimateTip: Estimated wallet proceeds if you listed everything at market prices. Steam listing UI is authoritative.

priceSource.median: Recent sale median on Steam Market
priceSource.lowest: Lowest listing (no recent sales on Steam)

buyOrder.noOrdersTitle: No buy orders on Steam Market for this item
buyOrder.highestTitle: Highest buy order — price if you sold to the order book immediately
buyOrder.averageTitle: Average price per unit across the order-book levels used to fill this stack.

marketPrice.noListingsTitle: No active Steam Market listings or recent sales for this item
marketPrice.notPricedTitle: Not priced (non-tradable or below Legendary gear)
marketPrice.totalIfListed: total if listed at market price

inUse.someEquipped: {{inUse}} of {{count}} owned are currently equipped; the rest are in your inventory/stash
inUse.allEquipped: All owned copies are currently equipped
